title: MACHEREY-NAGEL NucleoMag® Virus Protocol
author: MACHEREY-NAGEL
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Perform sample lysis
steps.instruction: Perform the lysis according to the NucleoMag® Virus user manual.

steps.title: Fill 12‑Well Buffer Reservoir
steps.instruction: Fill the 12‑Well Buffer Reservoir according to the table below.

steps.title: Resuspend V‑Beads and place
steps.instruction: Resuspend the NucleoMag® V‑Beads by vortexing and place them in Position A1 of the 2 mL Tube Rack.

steps.title: Load instrument deck
steps.instruction: Load the instrument deck according to the displayed positions.

steps.title: Place lysate block and start
steps.instruction: Place the Square‑well Block containing the lysates on the Magnetic Module and start the run.

steps.title: Execute binding step
steps.instruction: Run the Binding Step on the OT‑2 as defined in the protocol.

steps.title: Allow drying delay
steps.instruction: Allow the drying delay as programmed.

steps.title: Perform elution
steps.instruction: Run the Elution step on the OT‑2.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter protocol parameters in the OT‑2 software interface.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: Upload custom labware JSON files via More > Custom Labware > Add Labware.

steps.title: Upload .py protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file in the Protocol tab of the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” to start the automated workflow.
